summary: Frontend-only test of Milestone A (Shared George Platform + Butterfly). Butterfly ARRIVAL, resting, bubble legibility, no re-arrival on other admin pages, and Bridge regressions all PASSED. Two real bugs found: (1) [P0] the greeting bubble greets 'hello' instead of the admin's first name 'Garry' — backend presence endpoint uses admin.get('name') but the cms_admins record only has 'display_name'; (2) [P0] tapping the butterfly while the greeting bubble is still visible does nothing — GeorgeButterfly only wires onClick when phase === 'resting', so users clicking during 'landed' see no response. Backend endpoints /api/mcgs/george/presence and /api/mcgs/events/pending-approval both return sane payloads. Live end-to-end LLM turn on /admin/george/new-event was NOT executed (spec allows up to 60s per turn; time-boxed out) but the composer, suggestion chips, seed placeholder, and 'Start with George' button all render correctly. Aria-label collision confirmed: both mic button ('Talk to George') and butterfly ('Talk to George — tap to open') exist — the butterfly one is the correct target as documented.

critical.issue: Returns name='hello' (email prefix) for the admin whose display_name is 'Garry'. Root cause: /app/backend/mcgs_module.py:496 does `admin.get("name") or admin.get("email","").split("@")[0]`, but the cms_admins document exposes the first-name-y value on the `display_name` field. Should be `admin.get("display_name") or admin.get("name") or email-prefix`. This directly breaks P0 test 1 (butterfly greeting must include the admin's first name).

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping the butterfly is a no-op while the greeting bubble is still visible. onClick handler is only attached when phase === 'resting' (line 202 of GeorgeButterfly.tsx). During 'landed' (bubble showing, ~6.5s window) the click does nothing — no chat sheet opens. A user who reads the bubble and then clicks the butterfly straight away gets silent failure. Suggest: allow onTap when phase is 'landed' or 'resting' (both are post-arrival), and have onTap explicitly cancel the bubble timer.
ui_bugs.testID: button[aria-label="Talk to George — tap to open"]

ui_bugs.issue: Two buttons on the page carry aria-label starting with 'Talk to George' — the top-bar mic ('Talk to George') and the butterfly ('Talk to George — tap to open'). Not a blocker (spec calls this out), but a screen-reader user will hear two similarly-labelled controls. Consider giving the mic a distinct label like 'Talk to George (voice)'.

integration_issues.issue: Presence endpoint sends 'hello' as name → GeorgeButterfly.pickGreeting() renders 'Welcome back, hello. There's a draft…'. The rest of Mission Control (Morning Briefing 'Evening, Garry —') correctly resolves the admin's first name, proving the data exists; only /presence is wrong.

issues: Bubble is legible — measured 300×95px, wordBreak: normal, whiteSpace: normal. Not squeezed narrow. PASS on legibility.

action_items: Fix /app/backend/mcgs_module.py:496 → prefer admin.get('display_name') before email-prefix fallback so the butterfly bubble reads 'Welcome back, Garry.' (P0 test 1).

Fix GeorgeButterfly onTap gating: currently onClick={phase === 'resting' ? onTap : undefined} makes the butterfly unresponsive during the ~6.5s bubble window. Allow taps in 'landed' too (and cancel the bubble on tap).
Consider disambiguating the mic aria-label from the butterfly aria-label ('Talk to George' vs 'Talk to George — tap to open') for accessibility.
Re-verify P0 tests 3 & 4 (tap opens sheet, Escape/× close) after the onTap gate is fixed — my run could not observe the sheet opening while the bubble was still up.

P1 tests 7–10 (live Sonnet+Haiku round-trip on /admin/george/new-event) were not executed end-to-end due to the 60s-per-turn budget; UI wiring on that page is confirmed correct (composer, 3 chips, seed placeholder, 'Start with George' button, 'Leave and go back to the Bridge' link).
critical_code_review_comments: GeorgeButterfly.tsx line 202: gating onClick on 'resting' only is fragile — either extend to 'landed' or dismiss the bubble immediately when the button receives pointerdown. As written, users cannot open the chat sheet while the greeting is still on screen.
mcgs_module.py:496 duplicates the name-resolution logic that already exists elsewhere. Consider a shared helper `first_name_of(admin)` so Morning Briefing and /presence stay in sync.
GeorgeButterfly.tsx uses `window.localStorage.getItem('fp_cms_token')` — matches lib/cms-auth.ts. Good. But the doc-comment on line 60 still says 'cms_token' (stale). Minor.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (arrival, bubble legibility, resting, no-rearrival, Bridge/sidebar regressions all PASS; tap-to-open and first-name greeting FAIL)

rca_of_issue: P0 Bug 1 (wrong name in bubble): cms_admins collection stores first-name-y value under 'display_name', but mcgs_module.py:496 reads 'name'. `admin.get('name')` returns None → falls through to `admin.get('email','').split('@')[0]` → 'hello'. Fix: `presence['name'] = admin.get('display_name') or admin.get('name') or admin.get('email','').split('@')[0]`. P0 Bug 2 (tap during bubble does nothing): the click handler is gated behind phase === 'resting', but during the 6.5s bubble window phase is 'landed'. Two safe fixes: (a) accept taps in ['landed','resting'] and let onTap set setShowBubble(false) + clearTimeout(bubbleTimerRef.current); (b) transition to 'resting' immediately once the bubble is mounted, and drive the bubble lifetime purely off `showBubble`.
